items.stem: An AI tool drafts ad copy that includes a specific product statistic. Before publishing, what should the marketer do first?

options.text: Verify the statistic against a reliable source
options.rationale: Correct: AI can fabricate figures, so verification protects against false claims.

options.text: Publish immediately to hit the deadline
options.rationale: Publishing unverified claims risks false advertising.

options.text: Add more adjectives to make it persuasive
options.rationale: Persuasiveness does not fix an unverified claim.

options.text: Assume the AI checked the fact already
options.rationale: AI does not reliably verify facts.

items.explanation: Correct: AI can fabricate figures, so verification protects against false claims.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO actions support responsible use of AI in a marketing campaign? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Disclose AI-generated content where it could mislead
options.rationale: Correct: disclosure maintains trust and honesty.

options.text: Handle customer data within consent and privacy rules
options.rationale: Correct: lawful data use is a baseline obligation.

options.text: Scrape personal data without consent for targeting
options.rationale: Unlawful data collection creates legal and trust risk.

items.explanation: Correct: disclosure maintains trust and honesty.

items.stem: An AI dashboard shows a channel with high clicks but near-zero conversions. What is the most reasonable interpretation?

options.text: Clicks alone do not prove the channel drives valuable outcomes
options.rationale: Correct: a vanity metric can hide poor downstream performance.

options.text: The channel is definitely the best performer
options.rationale: High clicks without conversions is not strong performance.

options.text: Conversions do not matter if clicks are high
options.rationale: Conversions are the outcome that typically matters.
The pattern is common and interpretable, not necessarily an error.

items.explanation: Correct: a vanity metric can hide poor downstream performance.
